visibility_plan_entries.refusal: tiktok cannot honour --visibility unlisted on this route: TikTok Direct Post writes post_info.privacy_level: private is SELF_ONLY and public is PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE. TikTok has no unlisted level, and the level is validated against creator_info/query — a level the client may not use is refused, never downgraded. The request is refused rather than posting publicly; drop --visibility unlisted (the post is public there) or use a route that can honour it.
